title: 第114章 最强的战绩铭刻于华盛顿
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

格拉维克双腿猛地发力，脚下的石板地面瞬间塌陷出一个直径数米的深坑，金色宇宙能量如火山喷发般从他体内喷涌而出，带着足以熔穿钢铁的高温，朝李艾猛冲而来。

“去死吧，ZZZ！”

格拉维克咆哮着，粗壮的手臂抡起，带着震碎空气的爆响，一拳轰向李艾的头颅。

见状，李艾迎着格拉

而这个可恶的姬无病呢，由于之前一直没有出战来帮助，已经死去的美丽不打折和金银二老。

“洛天哥哥。”正当武思思分神之际，远处传来一阵惊呼，武思思听完，眼中立刻闪过一抹阴冷。

霍念笙看着桌上丰富的菜色，很厚道的给了沈倦一个鼓掌的奖励。

众人大吃一惊，看着如山一般庞大身躯的三眼魔虎一时不知如何是好。

“我是迫不得已。”凌潺说后轻轻叹了口气。陆辞本就是玩笑话，没打算真的去学，如今见她这样，只好闭上嘴。

白辛大人的口气绝对没有作为艾球球前任顶头上司一点点“吃醋”意思，他这样突然的将话锋一转完全就是为了夸奖我黎隐把我们这支救世联盟的队伍给带的好，不过我现在对于这种夸奖则是真的有一些麻木了。。。。。。

“好了，这就是所有注意的事项了。”云山说完最后一个，看着云韵说道。

闵夫，闵星辰，还有一陌生的阿姨，和闵夫大点年纪，约莫五十来岁了。

这么一走动，元宁才察觉到不对劲，脸上腾地红了，原来是她来了例假。

朱三叔还跪地求原谅，朱三婶大庭广众之下露出了自己和孩子们多年来留下的伤痕，声声血泪控诉，她不是没给过男人机会，但是这个男人死性不改，平日里对老婆孩子非打即骂，照这么下去，娘儿几个哪还有活路？

Gravek's legs suddenly exerted force, and the stone floor under his feet instantly collapsed into a deep pit with a diameter of several meters. Golden cosmic energy spurted out of his body like a volcanic eruption, rushing towards Li Ai with a high temperature enough to melt through steel.

"Go to hell, ZZZ!"

Gravek roared, swung his thick arms, and with an explosion that shattered the air, he punched Li Ai's head.

Seeing this, Li Ai greeted Gra

As for this abominable Ji Wubing, Meili Buzi and the two old men of gold and silver are already dead because they never came to help before.

"Brother Luo Tian." Just as Wu Sisi was distracted, an exclamation came from the distance. After hearing this, Wu Sisi's eyes immediately flashed with a cold look.

Huo Niansheng looked at the rich dishes on the table and gave Shen Juan a round of applause.

Everyone was shocked and didn't know what to do when they saw the three-eyed devil tiger with a huge body like a mountain.

"I have no choice." Ling Gong said and sighed softly.Lu Ci was just joking and had no intention of actually learning it. Now seeing her like this, he had no choice but to shut up.

Lord Bai Xin definitely didn't sound "jealous" as Ai Qiuqiu's former boss. He suddenly changed the subject just to praise me, Li Yin, for how well I led our Salvation Alliance team. However, I am really numb to this kind of praise now......

"Okay, these are all the things to pay attention to." Yunshan said the last one and looked at Yun Yun.

Min Fu, Min Xingchen, and a strange aunt, who were older than Min Fu, about fifty years old.

After moving like this, Yuanning realized something was wrong and her face turned red. It turned out that she was having her period.

Uncle Zhu even knelt down and begged for forgiveness. Third Aunt Zhu exposed the scars she and her children had sustained over the years in public, and complained with blood and tears. She had not given the man a chance, but this man would not change his ways. He would beat and scold his wife and children on weekdays. If this continued, how could the ladies survive?
